title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where's our next big discovery hiding?
Hmmm... I know! That way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wait!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's...not go in that direction.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Because... Well!
Because it is simply not very exciting!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There isn't much in that direction but the park, after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree! I passed through there yesterday, and there wasn't anything interesting around.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But there might be today!
Something big and wonderful, packed with smiles, might be waiting for us☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
As long as we're all together, I'm sure we'll find something fun♪
Neighborhood Expedition Team, set sail!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Wait, wait! Stop right there!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay... This time it'll work for sure!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Behold, an ordinary, everyday newspaper!
But if I pour in some of this milk... Look!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just like that, the milk has vanished!
Your applause, please!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! That was amazing, Minori! You did it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, look there. You can see it sogging through the paper.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! But I thought I did it perfectly this time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. Don't worry. Just a little more practice, and you'll have it ready for the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Next time it'll be a super-duper magical success for sure!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Haruka & Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?!
se_run_men_001_1
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff... We were too late...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ts-Tsukasa?! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Forgive me, Saki! We tried, but in the end we couldn't redirect Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Tsukasa, you knew Saki and the others were here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ack! No, I know nothing! I know not a single thing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But magic sure is fun, huh☆
Are you putting on a magic show with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Urk...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A magic show! What a wonderful idea. It's certainly rewarding to practice on your own, but it's best to perform for others.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: T-That's right! I've gotten really into stage magic lately!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember? We did magic together at the Seaside School!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just couldn't forget how much fun it was! I thought it would be even better to do it with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That really was impressive, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. So, that's what it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so great! I'd love to do more magic too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then let's do it again sometime! I'll be sure to practice a lot!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! It's a promise☆
I'm looking forward to it already!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Another amazing discovery! I didn't know everyone was so interested in magic!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
That definitely was a shock...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it should be just about time, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, is it that time already?
Indeed, it should be fine...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a place we would very much like to explore with you, Emu. Would you be willing to indulge our curiosity?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! That means it's Rui's turn to be captain!
Let's go find that excitement!
Nonogi Park
se_walk_men_003_1
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Captain Rui! Is this our next exploration zone?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmm? Look over there...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh?
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It is! It's Airi and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your lunches look so tasty! Are you having a picnic?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something like that! We're about to have a party.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We've just been waiting for the star to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup. But she just got here, so now we can start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She did?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, look! They beat us here!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, everyone. We brought the party goods.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It looks like everything's ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our practice ended up working out in the end, too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Everyone?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All the performers have taken their marks. Now, let the curtain rise!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! Something flew up into the sky!
Was that your fwooshy thing, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you read the banner under the drone for us, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh! There's something written on there!
Umm... “Happy Birthday, Emu”?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?! Wait, you mean, the star of the party...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That should be obvious! Who could be the star today but you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry things were a little awkward earlier.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were buying things for the party, so we were really nervous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was a surprise party, after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! So that's what it was!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We sort of panicked, too.
We didn't expect you to find us, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I even told you not to go to that park, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can only beg your forgiveness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, does that mean your magic practice...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We thought you'd like seeing some magic tricks at your party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We know you like this kind of thing, after all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You did all that for me?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm glad you're already having fun, Emu, but don't jump the gun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. The party's only just gotten started.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, let's celebrate! Here's to the very pillar of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyone...! Oh, I'm so, so happy!
Thank you so much for such a wonderhoy party!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The party was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad you enjoyed all those party props we bought.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Tsukasa said you would love them, and he was right on the mark. I didn't expect you to like the moustache glasses most of all, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha. I took lots of photos, so I'll send them over later.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
I'm so glad you enjoyed our magic show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I even got the newspaper trick to work!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It did still leak a little, though.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Really?!
And I thought I did so well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But since Emu liked it so much, it was worth all the time we spent practicing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And we promised to do more magic together later. I'm looking forward to the next time we hang out♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad you liked the lunch Shizuku and I made. Thanks for really digging in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You were right to suggest that taiyaki, too, Airi.
Emu had such a lovely smile on her face!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Her expressions are always so great that it makes you almost just as happy watching her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. May you have another healthy, energetic year. Let's have a meal together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I heard it's your birthday, Otori. You're probably sick of hearing it by now, but you know... Have a good one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Otori. It sounds as though you enjoyed your day exploring with Tsukasa and the others. I hope you'll consider inviting me on your next expedition.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And it would be fun to play games together again, too. If you would like, please also invite Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Mafuyu & Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I heard all about it from Airi and the others. It sounds like it was a great party.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She did say the surprise almost got out a few times, and everyone panicked a little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They must have been freaking out! But still, what a fun-sounding party!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sure it was a very lively one.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Otori. I would love to speak more with you, at the student council or any other time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Once more! Happy birthday, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It took quite a lot of coordination, so I'm as pleased as punch you loved our surprise party!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Things came so close to falling apart. Why did we have to run into basically everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu's fun radar is no slouch, after all. We should have expected it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, as they say, all's well that ends well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha, that's true. Let's continue to strive for that level of fun and excitement in all we do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Emu, let's keep working hard together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right! Let us shine as bright as we can upon the stage, together!
I'll be counting on you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you for celebrating my birthday with me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We went out on an expedition, and found so many friends, and sooo much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! I'd love to go on an expedition with everyone who celebrated with me today! I'll send out the invitations now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See you later, everyone!
Won-won-wonderhoy!!!
